event: The Hou Hanshu Kushan account, based on reports current to c. 125 CE, names Kujula Kadphises and his son (Vima Takto) but not Kanishka, and gives no Kushan regnal date
date_raw: Report horizon c. Jianwu to Yongning era reports, compiled in Hou Hanshu
firmness_reason: Argument from silence/report horizon: suggests Kanishka had not risen (or was unknown at court) by c. 125, but the account's India coverage is thin
notes: Campaign case 2: soft lower bound on the era epoch; combined with the Bodiao entry it confines the epoch to c. 125-165 and excludes 78 CE.

chinese_source: Sanguozhi, ch. 3 (annals of Emperor Ming of Wei)
event: The king of the Da Yuezhi, Bodiao (Vasudeva I), sends tribute; the Wei emperor grants him the title King of the Da Yuezhi Intimate with Wei
firmness_reason: Annalistic entry with reign-era date; the bound it generates depends on the Bodiao = Vasudeva I identification (a Vasudeva II has been proposed)
notes: Vasudeva I's era-dated inscriptions run years 64-98; his being on the throne in 229 excludes a 78 CE era epoch (which would put 229 in era year 151) and is consistent with 127 or 144.
